净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutation of CROSS-001: preserves the core price-volume coherence mechanism (10-day return multiplied by volume deviation) but replaces the standard volume z-score (mean/std) with a robust z-score using median and MAD. This reduces the influence of outlier volume observations, aiming to improve IC and MI stability without disrupting the RankIC strength of the parent.

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change(10)
  2. 计算 vol_median：volume.滚动窗口(20).median()
  3. 计算 vol_mad：(volume - vol_median).abs().滚动窗口(20).median()
  4. 计算 vol_robust_z：(volume - vol_median) / (vol_mad * 1.4826)
  5. 计算 vol_robust_z：vol_robust_z.clip(-3, 3)
  6. 计算 neg_returns：returns.clip(upper=0)
  7. 计算 downside_std：neg_returns.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  8. 计算 total_std：returns.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  9. 计算 ratio：downside_std / total_std
  10. 计算 ratio：ratio
  11. 计算 factor：ret * vol_robust_z * (1 - ratio)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_stress_adjusted_momentum_robust(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change(10) vol_median = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20).median() vol_mad = (df_copy["str">'volume'] - vol_median).abs().rolling(20).median() vol_robust_z = (df_copy["str">'volume'] - vol_median) / (vol_mad * 1.4826).replace(0, np.nan) vol_robust_z = vol_robust_z.clip(-3, 3) returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() neg_returns = returns.clip(upper=0) downside_std = neg_returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std() total_std = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std() ratio = downside_std / total_std.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = ratio.fillna(0.5) factor = ret * vol_robust_z * (1 - ratio) factor.name = "factor_volume_stress_adjusted_momentum_robust" "kw">class="kw">return factor
